paragraph: A recent study found that placing live green plants in office spaces increased employees' focus duration and lowered their stress hormone levels during the workday. Researchers observed the effect across several departments, though they noted that the improvement was most pronounced in rooms that already received plenty of natural daylight. These findings have encouraged companies to reconsider their workspace designs.

cards.text: Adding plants to offices contributes to employees becoming more focused during work.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metin bunu neredeyse birebir söylüyor  yani 'odaklanma süresini artırmış'; hiçbir genelleme yok, sadece tekrar — çıkarım değil.

cards.text: Integrating natural elements into a workspace can have a positive effect on employees' psychological well-being.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Metindeki 'yeşil bitki'yi 'doğal unsur', 'stres hormonunun düşmesi'ni 'psikolojik refah' olarak genelliyor; metinden %100 çıkar ama birebir yazmaz — altın orta, 'can' ile temkinli.

cards.text: Employees who have no plants in their office are less successful and burn out earlier than those who do.
cards.label: over
cards.why: Metin yalnızca bitki EKLEMENİN faydasını söylüyor; bitkisi olmayanların 'daha başarısız/daha erken tükendiği' KIYASI metinde yok — sınırı aşan spekülasyon.

paragraph: Data from a sleep clinic indicated that participants who used their smartphones in bed took longer to fall asleep than those who read printed books beforehand. The researchers attributed this partly to the blue light emitted by screens, which can suppress the release of melatonin, a hormone that signals the body to prepare for rest.

cards.text: Smartphones will eventually have to be banned from all bedrooms to solve sleep problems.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Yasaklanması gerekecek' geleceğe dönük tahmin/politika sıçraması, 'tüm yatak odaları' mutlak; metin böyle bir sonuç ya da öneri içermiyor.

cards.text: Reading printed books is the healthiest possible way to guarantee a good night's sleep for everyone.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'En sağlıklı yol', 'garanti' ve 'herkes' mutlak/üstünlük iddiaları metnin verisini aşıyor; metin sadece kitabın telefona GÖRE daha hızlı uykuya daldırdığını söylüyor.

cards.text: Exposure to screen light before bed may interfere with the body's natural process of preparing for sleep.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Ekran ışığı → melatonin baskılanması → uykuya hazırlanma zincirini metinden genelliyor; 'may' ile temkinli, sınırı aşmıyor — geçerli çıkarım.

paragraph: The invention of the printing press in the fifteenth century dramatically reduced the cost of producing books, which had previously been copied slowly by hand. As printed materials became more affordable, literacy rates in several European regions began to climb, and new ideas circulated far more quickly than they had before. The widespread availability of books played a foundational role in the subsequent intellectual rebirth of Europe.

cards.text: Without the printing press, no scientific progress at all would have been possible in Europe.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Matbaa olmasa HİÇBİR bilimsel ilerleme olmazdı' mutlak ve karşı-olgusal iddiası; metin matbaanın etkisini anlatıyor, böyle bir zorunluluk kurmuyor.

cards.text: Making written knowledge cheaper can widen ordinary people's access to education.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Ucuzlayan kitap + artan okuryazarlığı 'sıradan insanların eğitime erişiminin genişlemesi' olarak genelliyor; metinden çıkar ama birebir yazmaz — altın orta.

cards.text: The accessibility of printed materials can play a role in fostering literacy among certain populations.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'basılı materyallerin daha uygun fiyatlı olmasını' 'basılı materyallerin erişilebilirliği', 'okuryazarlık oranlarının artmasını' 'okuryazarlığı teşvik etmek' olarak genelliyor.

paragraph: Recent environmental assessments reveal that widespread adoption of electric vehicles significantly reduces urban air pollution levels. However, experts stress that the overall climate benefit depends heavily on the local electricity grid. If a region relies predominantly on coal-fired power plants to generate its electricity, the net carbon footprint reduction remains minimal. Therefore, transitioning to electric mobility must be coordinated with energy grid modernization to achieve optimal results.

cards.text: The environmental advantages of battery-powered cars are influenced by how the local electricity is produced.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'Elektrikli araçları' 'pil gücüyle çalışan arabalar', 'yerel şebekeyi' de 'elektriğin nasıl üretildiği' olarak genelliyor; metinden mantıksal olarak çıkar.

cards.text: Electric vehicles are always the absolute best choice for eliminating global warming regardless of where you live.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Her zaman en iyi tercih' ve 'nerede yaşarsanız yaşayın' mutlak/üstünlük iddiaları metnin yerel şebekeye bağlılık vurgusunu tamamen aşıyor.

cards.text: Widespread adoption of electric vehicles decreases urban air pollution levels in many cities.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki ilk cümleyi neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine tekrar ediyor  yani 'hava kirliliğini azaltır'; hiçbir soyutlama içermiyor.

paragraph: A comprehensive study on remote work arrangements indicated that employees working from home reported higher job satisfaction and improved work-life balance. Nevertheless, the study also highlighted a notable rise in feelings of professional isolation, especially among younger staff members who rely heavily on workplace socialization for career mentorship and networking. Without regular physical interactions, maintaining cohesive corporate cultures and providing effective guidance for new hires becomes significantly more challenging.

cards.text: Allowing staff to work outside the office may present specific social challenges for less experienced personnel.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'Evden çalışmayı' 'ofis dışında çalışmak', 'genç personeli' de 'daha az deneyimli personel' olarak başarıyla genelliyor; 'may' ile temkinli çıkarım.

cards.text: Younger employees suffer from isolation more than older colleagues when working remotely.
cards.label: over
cards.why: Metinde gençlerin izolasyon hissettiği söyleniyor ama yaşlı meslektaşlarıyla karşılaştıran 'more than' KIYASI metinde bulunmuyor.

cards.text: Younger employees will fail in their careers if they are forced to work from home indefinitely.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Kariyerlerinde başarısız olacaklar' mutlak gelecek tahmini ve 'eğer forced' karşı-olgusal iddiası metnin sunduğu 'izolasyon hissi' verisini fersah fersah aşıyor.

paragraph: Analyses of organic crops show they contain lower levels of pesticide residues compared to conventionally grown alternatives. While proponents claim this makes organic diets inherently healthier, clinical studies have yet to demonstrate any long-term health differences in consumers. Thus, the nutritional superiority of organic food remains a subject of ongoing scientific debate. Consumers are advised to focus on overall diet quality rather than assuming that organic labels alone guarantee better health.

cards.text: Reducing pesticide exposure through diet has not yet been definitively linked to measurable long-term clinical benefits.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'Organik beslenmeyi' 'tarım ilacı maruziyetini azaltmak', 'sağlık farkı olmamasını' da 'klinik faydayla kesin olarak ilişkilendirilememesi' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Conventional crops have higher pesticide residues, while organic food's long-term health superiority is not yet clinically proven.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki tüm bilgileri doğrudan tekrar ediyor; zihinsel bir genelleme veya satır arası çıkarım barındırmıyor.

cards.text: Buying organic food is the single most important lifestyle change to guarantee a disease-free life.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tek en önemli yaşam tarzı değişikliği' üstünlük iddiası ve 'hastalıksız yaşamı garanti etme' mutlak ifadesi bilimsel tartışma aşamasındaki metni aşıyor.

paragraph: During the Pax Romana, Roman merchants established extensive maritime trade networks that connected Italy with ports in Egypt and India. Historical records show that precious spices, silks, and exotic animals flowed into Rome, while glass and olive oil were exported. This economic interdependence fostered cultural exchanges that reshaped Roman social customs. These commercial interactions created lasting cultural bridges, demonstrating that trade was a powerful force for social integration in the ancient world.

cards.text: Cultural exchange between Rome and India would have been impossible without the export of olive oil.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Zeytinyağı ihracatı olmasaydı kültürel değişim imkansız olurdu' şeklinde kurulan karşı-olgusal neden sıçraması metnin verilerini aşıyor.

cards.text: International commerce in antiquity could serve as a channel for transmitting diverse cultural traditions.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'Roma deniz ticaretini' 'antik çağda uluslararası ticaret', 'sosyal adetlerin değişmesini' de 'kültürel geleneklerin aktarılması' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Roman merchants established extensive trade routes by sea, exporting glass and olive oil while importing spices and silks.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki tarihi verileri birebir kelimelerle tekrar ediyor; herhangi bir zihinsel soyutlama veya çıkarım yok.

paragraph: Marine biologists have discovered microplastics in the digestive tracts of deep-sea organisms living thousands of meters below the surface. These synthetic particles absorb hazardous chemical pollutants from the surrounding water, which then bioaccumulate as they move up the food chain. This suggests that plastic waste is infiltrating even the most remote marine ecosystems. This extensive contamination highlights the urgent need for systemic reforms in how plastic products are manufactured, consumed, and discarded globally.

cards.text: Human-made materials can contaminate ocean biotas at extreme depths through progressive biological accumulation.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'Mikroplastikleri' 'insan yapımı materyaller', 'derin deniz canlılarını' da 'ekstrem derinliklerdeki okyanus biyotası' olarak ustalıkla genelliyor.

cards.text: Synthetic waste is infiltrating marine ecosystems, and particles are accumulating up the food chain.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki 'plastik atıkların sızması' ve 'gıda zincirinde birikme' cümlelerini doğrudan tekrar ediyor; çıkarım barındırmıyor.

cards.text: All deep-sea creatures will soon go extinct unless we completely ban plastic production globally.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tüm derin deniz canlıları tükenecek' mutlak gelecek tahmini ve 'üretim tamamen yasaklanmadıkça' politik dayatması metnin sınırlarını fersah fersah aşıyor.

paragraph: Research indicates that young children who participate in structured music lessons exhibit faster development in spatial-temporal reasoning compared to their peers. Pediatricians suggest that translating musical notes on a page into physical movements on an instrument exercises the same neural networks used for complex mathematical problem-solving during later academic years. Early childhood educators therefore argue that learning to play an instrument provides cognitive advantages that persist throughout a student's academic life.

cards.text: Without early music lessons, children will never achieve high academic success in mathematics or engineering.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Müzik dersi almazlarsa asla başarıya ulaşamazlar' şeklindeki mutlak karşı-olgusal iddia metnin sunduğu gelişimsel korelasyonu aşıyor.

cards.text: Music lessons are the absolute best way to guarantee a child becomes a genius.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Dahi olmayı garanti etmenin kesinlikle en iyi yolu' şeklindeki aşırı üstünlük ve kesinlik iddiaları metindeki bilimsel bulguları saptırıyor.

cards.text: Learning to play an instrument during childhood can stimulate cognitive faculties associated with mathematical thinking.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'Notaları enstrümana dökmeyi' 'enstrüman çalmak', 'uzamsal akıl yürütmeyi' 'matematiksel düşünmeyle ilişkili bilişsel yetiler' olarak genelliyor.

paragraph: The rapid expansion of e-commerce has led to a major surge in last-mile delivery vehicles, creating severe traffic congestion in urban areas. Logistics experts argue that implementing consolidated micro-hubs in city centers could streamline deliveries. By storing products closer to consumers, companies can utilize smaller electric cargo bikes, reducing both emission levels and traffic volume.

cards.text: E-commerce expansion has increased delivery vehicles, which causes traffic congestion in urban areas.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki ilk cümleyi neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalıyor; herhangi bir soyutlama veya satır arası okuma içermiyor.

cards.text: Micro-hubs are the only possible way to completely eliminate traffic congestion in all major world cities.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tek olası yol' mutlak ifadesi ve 'tüm dünya şehirlerindeki trafiği tamamen yok etmek' aşırı yorumu metnin sunduğu lojistik öneriyi aşıyor.

cards.text: Consolidating distribution centers in metropolitan hubs may help mitigate some of the negative externalities of digital retail.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'Mikro-depolar kurmayı' 'dağıtım merkezlerini birleştirmek', 'e-ticaret kirliliğini' ise 'dijital perakendenin olumsuz dışsallıkları' olarak genelliyor.

paragraph: Artificial intelligence models trained on millions of medical images can now detect lung abnormalities with high accuracy. While some tech enthusiasts believe these algorithms will soon replace human radiologists entirely, healthcare administrators emphasize that AI lacks the clinical judgement required for complex, multi-system diagnoses. Consequently, AI currently functions as a secondary screening tool. Radiologists can use these algorithms to identify potential risks quickly, but the final diagnostic decisions still require human experience and comprehensive clinical context.

cards.text: AI algorithms will soon replace human radiologists completely in all hospitals worldwide.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'tüm dünyadaki hastanelerde tamamen' mutlak ve 'will' kesin gelecek tahmini metindeki ikincil araç vurgusunu aşıyor.

cards.text: Computational algorithms may serve as supportive instruments in diagnostic imaging without replacing human medical professionals.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'AI modellerini' 'hesaplamalı algoritmalar', 'ikincil tarama aracını' da 'destekleyici enstrümanlar' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Machine learning systems are capable of assisting medical professionals by identifying anomalies in diagnostic scans.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'AI models' ve 'lung abnormalities' kavramlarını 'makine öğrenimi sistemleri' ve 'tanısal taramalardaki anomaliler' olarak genelliyor.

paragraph: Exploring the ocean floor has revealed hydrothermal vents that support unique ecosystems, operating completely independent of sunlight. These organisms utilize chemosynthesis, converting toxic chemicals from the earth's crust into organic energy. Astrobiologists believe that studying these extreme life forms provides crucial clues about potential habitats on icy moons like Europa. By examining how life thrives under such extreme conditions, scientists can better define the parameters of habitability in the solar system.

cards.text: Without studying hydrothermal vents, we will never discover alien life in our solar system.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'vents olmasaydı asla keşfedemezdik' şeklinde kurulan karşı-olgusal mutlak gelecek tahmini metni aşıyor.

cards.text: Investigating extreme environments on Earth may help scientists identify biosignatures on other planetary bodies.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'okyanus tabanını incelemeyi' 'Dünya'daki ekstrem ortamları', 'Europa'daki yaşam alanlarını' da 'diğer gezegenlerdeki yaşam izleri' olarak başarıyla genelliyor.

cards.text: Hydrothermal vents on the ocean floor support ecosystems that utilize chemosynthesis instead of sunlight.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki bilimsel veriyi doğrudan tekrar ediyor; hiçbir soyutlama veya satır arası çıkarım içermiyor.

paragraph: The rapid growth of solar and wind energy has highlighted the urgent need for grid-scale battery storage solutions. Because these renewable sources are intermittent, power grids often struggle to maintain stability during peak demand hours. Advanced lithium-ion and flow batteries offer a mechanism to store excess energy generated during sunny or windy periods for later distribution.

cards.text: The rapid growth of solar and wind energy has highlighted the urgent need for grid-scale battery storage.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki ilk cümleyi neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine tekrar ediyor; hiçbir soyutlama içermiyor.

cards.text: Advanced storage technologies can help mitigate the reliability challenges associated with intermittent power generation.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'batarya çözümlerini' 'gelişmiş depolama teknolojileri', 'istikrar sorunlarını' da 'güvenilirlik zorlukları' olarak başarıyla genelliyor.

cards.text: Advanced lithium-ion and flow batteries store excess energy generated during sunny or windy periods.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin son cümlesini neredeyse birebir kopyalayıp tekrar ediyor; zihinsel bir çıkarım süreci barındırmıyor.

paragraph: Neurolinguistic studies indicate that individuals who speak more than one language regularly demonstrate enhanced cognitive flexibility and executive control. Managing two active linguistic systems simultaneously forces the brain to constantly resolve competition, which exercises neural networks responsible for task-switching and selective attention, delaying the onset of age-related cognitive decline. This continuous mental exercise essentially keeps the brain active, helping to preserve vital cognitive capacities during the natural process of aging.

cards.text: Consistent multilingual communication may reinforce the neurological mechanisms that govern attention and adaptability.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'iki dil konuşmayı' 'çok dilli iletişim', 'seçici dikkat ve esnekliği' de 'dikkat ve uyum sağlama mekanizmaları' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Monolingual people always suffer from severe cognitive decline much earlier than bilingual individuals.
cards.label: over
cards.why: Tek dilli insanların 'her zaman çok daha erken ve şiddetli zihinsel gerileme yaşayacağı' KIYASI ve MUTLAK iddiası metinde bulunmuyor.

cards.text: Bilingual individuals have enhanced cognitive flexibility and executive control due to managing two active linguistic systems.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki ilk iki cümleyi neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalayarak tekrar ediyor; satır arası çıkarım barındırmıyor.

paragraph: Research in urban climatology suggests that increasing vegetation cover in highly built-up areas significantly mitigates the urban heat island effect. Satellite data confirms that parks and green roofs lower surface temperatures by providing shade and facilitating evapotranspiration. Consequently, city planners are incorporating green infrastructure into modern architectural codes. By replacing heat-absorbing concrete with living surfaces, modern cities are actively working to create more comfortable and livable environments for their residents.

cards.text: Increasing vegetation cover in built-up areas mitigates the urban heat island effect.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki ilk cümleyi neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalayarak tekrar ediyor; hiçbir soyutlama içermiyor.

cards.text: Expanding plant coverage in municipal environments can contribute to lowering ambient temperatures in concrete zones.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'yeşilliği artırmayı' 'bitki örtüsünü genişletmek', 'ısı adasını hafifletmeyi' de 'beton bölgelerdeki ortam sıcaklığını düşürmek' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Urban green spaces are the absolute best way to completely eliminate air pollution in all major world cities.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Kesinlikle en iyi yol' üstünlük iddiası ve 'tüm büyük şehirlerdeki hava kirliliğini tamamen yok etmek' mutlak aşırı yorumu metni aşıyor.

paragraph: Clinical trials evaluating mindfulness meditation have shown that daily practice significantly reduces symptoms of generalized anxiety. Neurological scans of participants revealed a reduction in the size of the amygdala, the brain structure responsible for processing fear and stress. Researchers conclude that mental training can alter the physical architecture of the brain. These findings suggest that consistent mental training can actively reshape neural networks, offering a powerful non-pharmacological approach to stress management.

cards.text: Daily mindfulness meditation is the most effective psychological therapy for everyone suffering from anxiety.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'En etkili psikolojik terapi' üstünlük iddiası ve 'anksiyete yaşayan herkes' mutlak ifadesi metnin klinik sınırlarını aşıyor.

cards.text: Mindfulness meditation reduces anxiety and alters the physical structure of the brain.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki ilk ve son cümlelerdeki bulguları neredeyse aynen tekrar ediyor; zihinsel bir çıkarım barındırmıyor.

cards.text: Systematic mental exercise may lead to structural changes in the neurological regions associated with emotional regulation.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'zihinsel antrenmanı' 'sistematik zihinsel egzersiz', 'amygdala küçülmesini' de 'duygusal düzenlemeyle ilişkili yapısal değişiklikler' olarak genelliyor.

paragraph: The accumulation of defunct satellites and rocket stages in Low Earth Orbit has created an increasingly hazardous environment for space missions. Even tiny paint flecks, traveling at hypervelocity, can puncture critical spacecraft components. Aerospace organizations are testing active debris removal concepts, such as giant nets and harpoons, to prevent catastrophic collisions. If these experimental technologies prove successful, they could safeguard future exploration by systematically cleaning up the most congested regions of orbit.

cards.text: Defunct orbital materials must be banned immediately to guarantee that space tourism will become 100 percent safe.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Derhal yasaklanmalıdır' politika önermesi ve '%100 güvenli uzay turizmini garanti etmek' mutlak gelecek tahmini metni aşıyor.

cards.text: Man-made orbital waste pose a threat to space exploration, requiring innovative physical intervention methods to secure missions.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'uzay çöplerini' 'insan yapımı yörünge atıkları', 'ağlar ve zıpkınları' da 'yenilikçi fiziksel müdahale yöntemleri' olarak başarıyla genelliyor.

cards.text: Technological solutions may be needed to mitigate the hazards posed by inactive objects in low orbit.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'çöp temizleme konseptlerini test etmeyi' 'teknolojik çözümler gerekebilir', 'defunct satellites'i de 'yörüngedeki inaktif nesneler' olarak genelliyor.

paragraph: Surveys indicate that while e-books are highly valued for their convenience and searchability, printed books continue to dominate the market due to sensory appeal and emotional connection. Readers often report that the tactile experience of turning pages and the physical presence of a bookshelf foster a deeper cognitive connection with the text. This physical engagement with the text appears to enhance comprehension and memory, explaining why paper books remain popular in the digital age.

cards.text: The tangible aspects of a reading medium can play a significant role in how readers engage with literature.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'sayfa çevirme ve kitaplık hissini' 'okuma ortamının somut yönleri', 'metinle bilişsel bağı' da 'edebiyatla etkileşim kurma biçimi' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: E-books are valued for convenience, but readers prefer printed books because of the tactile experience of turning pages.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki ankete dayalı tercih verilerini neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalayarak tekrar ediyor; çıkarım içermiyor.

cards.text: Physical books will completely disappear from the market because e-books are far more convenient and searchable.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Fiziksel kitaplar tamamen piyasadan silinecek' mutlak gelecek tahmini metindeki basılı kitapların piyasa üstünlüğü verisine taban tabana zıttır.

paragraph: Coral reefs occupy less than one percent of the ocean floor, yet they support over twenty-five percent of all marine species. Rising ocean temperatures, driven by climate change, induce coral bleaching by expelling the symbiotic algae that provide food and color to the corals. This ecological disruption threatens coastal protection and local fisheries, necessitating global carbon reduction.

cards.text: Thermal stress on marine ecosystems can disrupt biological relationships that are critical for preserving diverse aquatic life.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'artan okyanus sıcaklıklarını' 'termal stres', 'alglerin dışarı atılmasını' da 'ortak yaşam ilişkilerinin bozulması' olarak ustalıkla genelliyor.

cards.text: Coral reefs support over twenty-five percent of marine species but rising temperatures induce bleaching by expelling algae.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki oranları ve biyolojik olayları doğrudan kelimesi kelimesine tekrar ediyor; hiçbir zihinsel çıkarım barındırmıyor.

cards.text: All marine species will go extinct within the next decade unless we completely eliminate global carbon emissions.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tüm deniz türleri on yıl içinde yok olacak' mutlak gelecek tahmini ve 'karbonu tamamen sıfırlama' mutlak politika önerisi metni aşıyor.

paragraph: Incorporating zinc oxide nanoparticles into food packaging materials has been shown to inhibit the growth of common foodborne pathogens like E. coli. These nanomaterials interact with bacterial cell walls, disrupting their structural integrity. This technology extends the shelf life of perishable goods, reducing food waste throughout the global supply chain. By preventing bacterial growth at the microscopic level, this innovative approach could revolutionize the food packaging industry and enhance global food safety.

cards.text: Zinc oxide nanoparticles inhibit foodborne pathogens and extend the shelf life of perishable goods.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki patojen engelleme ve raf ömrü uzatma bilgisini doğrudan kelimesi kelimesine tekrar ediyor; çıkarım içermiyor.

cards.text: Applying microscopic material engineering to food preservation can assist in decreasing the degradation of perishable supply stocks.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'çinko oksit nanopartiküllerini' 'mikroskobik malzeme mühendisliği', 'raf ömrünü uzatmayı' de 'bozulabilir stokların bozulmasını azaltmak' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Nanoparticles in packaging are the best possible solution to completely prevent all foodborne illnesses worldwide.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'En iyi olası çözüm' üstünlük iddiası ve 'dünyadaki tüm gıda kaynaklı hastalıkları tamamen önleme' mutlaklığı metnin bilimsel sınırlarını aşıyor.

paragraph: Epidemiological studies indicate that moderate coffee consumption, defined as three to four cups daily, is associated with a lower risk of cardiovascular disease. However, researchers caution that these benefits are heavily offset if individuals add excessive sugar or artificial creamers. Moreover, high caffeine intake can trigger sleep disturbances in sensitive populations. To maximize the natural health benefits of coffee, individuals should limit additives and monitor their caffeine sensitivity, especially before bedtime.

cards.text: Adding any amount of sugar to coffee will completely destroy all of its heart-healthy antioxidant properties.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Herhangi bir miktarda şeker eklemenin tüm faydaları tamamen yok edeceği' şeklindeki mutlak ve iddialı gelecek tahmini metni aşıyor.

cards.text: People who drink more than four cups of coffee daily are guaranteed to suffer from severe cardiac issues.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Dört bardaktan fazla içenlerin kalp sorunları yaşayacağı garantidir' şeklindeki mutlak karşı-olgusal ve kesin iddia metni aşıyor.

cards.text: The potential cardiovascular benefits of certain dietary habits may be neutralized by supplementary food ingredients.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: 'kahve içmeyi' 'belirli diyet alışkanlıkları', 'şeker ve krema eklemeyi' de 'takviye gıda bileşenleri' olarak başarıyla genelliyor.

paragraph: A study of high school students during remote learning periods revealed that self-regulated learning skills were the strongest predictor of academic success. Students who actively scheduled their study blocks and limited screen distractions outperformed their peers. Conversely, those who relied solely on teacher-led instruction struggled to adapt to the unstructured environment. This disparity suggests that online education requires a high level of student independence and active engagement to achieve positive learning outcomes.

paragraph: The transition to steam-powered machinery during the Industrial Revolution dramatically increased manufacturing output across Europe. However, this shift forced thousands of traditional artisans out of work, leading to widespread social unrest and the rise of organized labor movements. Historians note that technological advancement often carries severe transitional costs for the working class. This historical pattern demonstrates that rapid technological progress can create deep economic divisions before the broader social benefits are fully realized.

paragraph: Intensive monoculture farming has depleted essential micronutrients in agricultural soils worldwide, reducing crop yield resilience. These methods restore soil biodiversity, ensuring that farming systems can withstand extreme weather events without relying heavily on chemical fertilizers. By fostering a diverse soil ecosystem, farmers can protect their crops from pests and drought, ensuring sustainable food production for future generations.

paragraph: A transport economics study analyzed the impact of making public transit entirely free in several medium-sized cities. Therefore, while universal free transport sounds appealing, targeted economic assistance often provides a more sustainable path to maintaining high-quality transit systems.

paragraph: While artificial sweeteners are commonly consumed to aid in weight loss, clinical trials suggest they can alter gut microbiota composition in ways that negatively affect glucose tolerance. These clinical insights highlight the complex relationship between artificial dietary additives, metabolic health, and the delicate balance of the gut microbiome.

paragraph: Neuroscientific research shows that regular cardiovascular exercise increases the volume of the hippocampus, the brain region critical for verbal memory and learning. paragraph: Vertical farming systems grow crops in stacked layers inside controlled indoor environments, using ninety-five percent less water than conventional agriculture. By eliminating the need for long-distance transport and pesticides, vertical farms could provide fresh, local produce to growing urban populations year-round.

paragraph: Developmental psychologists have found that adolescents are highly susceptible to peer influence during risk-taking decisions, such as reckless driving or substance experimentation. This neurological mechanism explains why adolescents are uniquely prone to peer-driven choices, prioritizing social approval over potential long-term safety risks.

By securing a reliable water supply, communities can break the cycle of poverty, allowing children to focus on their education and future opportunities.

paragraph: While wind energy is a crucial pillar of carbon-free electricity generation, the rotating blades of large turbines pose a serious threat to migratory birds and bats. By balancing the demands of clean energy generation with ecological preservation, these innovative systems aim to make wind power safer for flying wildlife.

paragraph: Experimental sleep deprivation in healthy adults shows that staying awake for over twenty-four hours reduces glucose metabolism in the prefrontal cortex. cards.text: Bilingual infants show greater cognitive flexibility in task-switching than monolingual peers.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki 'iki dilli bebeklerin görev geçişlerinde daha fazla bilişsel esneklik gösterdiği' bilgisini doğrudan tekrar ediyor; çıkarım değildir.

cards.text: Managing multiple languages during infancy can stimulate the development of executive control functions.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Metindeki 'iki aktif dili yönetmenin beynin yönetici ağlarını çalıştırması' bilgisini, 'yönetici kontrol işlevlerinin gelişimini uyarabilir' şeklinde genelliyor.

cards.text: Bilingual children will always be more successful in school and careers than monolingual children.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Her zaman okul ve kariyerde daha başarılı olacaklar' şeklinde sınırları aşan mutlak bir gelecek tahmini içeriyor; metin sadece bilişsel esneklikten bahsediyor.

paragraph: Deep-sea hydrothermal vents support complex ecosystems that thrive completely independent of sunlight. Instead of photosynthesis, the primary producers in these dark habitats utilize chemosynthesis, converting toxic chemicals like hydrogen sulfide into organic energy. These extreme environments challenge traditional textbook definitions of life, suggesting that biological processes could exist under vastly different conditions on other planets.

cards.text: The discovery of chemosynthetic ecosystems suggests that biological life may emerge without relying on solar energy.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Güneş ışığına bağımlı olmama durumunu 'güneş enerjisine güvenmeden biyolojik yaşamın ortaya çıkabilmesi' şeklinde genelliyor; 'may' ile temkinlidir.

cards.text: Extreme environments challenge traditional textbook definitions of life, suggesting biological processes on other planets.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin son cümlesini neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalıyor; özgün bir genelleme veya satır arası çıkarım içermiyor.

cards.text: Hydrogen sulfide is the only source of energy that can sustain biological life in the absence of sunlight.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tek enerji kaynağı' ifadesiyle metinde olmayan mutlaklık ve sınırlama içeriyor; metin bunu sadece bir örnek olarak sunmaktadır.

paragraph: While major corporations initially embraced remote work to cut real estate costs, recent surveys reveal a steady push toward hybrid models. Management executives cite a decline in spontaneous collaborative innovations as the primary drawback of fully remote setups. Nonetheless, employees consistently report higher job satisfaction and better work-life balance when allowed to work from home at least twice a week.

cards.text: Flexible working arrangements can play a beneficial role in enhancing employee well-being.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Metindeki 'haftada en az iki gün evden çalışma ve yüksek iş memnuniyeti' ilişkisini 'esnek çalışma düzeni' ve 'çalışan refahı' olarak başarıyla genelliyor.

cards.text: Allowing employees to work from home at least twice a week leads to higher job satisfaction.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin son cümlesindeki verileri neredeyse aynen tekrar ediyor; zihinsel bir soyutlama veya çıkarım barındırmıyor.

cards.text: Spontaneous collaborative innovations can only happen when employees work in the same physical office.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Sadece çalışanlar aynı ofisteyken gerçekleşebilir' şeklinde metnin sınırlarını aşan mutlak ve sınırlayıcı bir iddia barındırıyor.

paragraph: In ancient Mesopotamia, the development of sophisticated canal systems allowed farmers to cultivate the arid plains between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers. This agricultural surplus facilitated rapid urbanization and the emergence of a centralized administrative class. However, prolonged irrigation gradually caused soil salinization, eventually rendering vast tracts of land barren and contributing to the decline of early city-states.

cards.text: Human efforts to control natural water resources can lead to unintended long-term ecological consequences.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Kanal yapımı ve tuzlanmayı 'doğal su kaynaklarını kontrol etmenin beklenmedik ekolojik sonuçları' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Without sophisticated canal systems, no civilization at all could have ever emerged in ancient Mesopotamia.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Kanal sistemleri olmadan hiçbir medeniyet asla ortaya çıkamazdı' mutlak ve karşı-olgusal iddiasıdır.

cards.text: The decline of early city-states was entirely caused by agricultural salinity, with no political factors involved.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tamamen tuzlanmadan kaynaklandı, hiçbir politik faktör yoktu' şeklinde metni aşan dışlayıcı ve mutlak bir iddia taşır.

paragraph: Clinical trials indicate that sleep-deprived individuals consistently exhibit elevated levels of ghrelin, a hormone that stimulates appetite, coupled with reduced levels of leptin, which signals fullness. Consequently, participants deprived of adequate rest showed a marked preference for high-calorie carbohydrates over nutrient-dense foods. This biochemical shift explains why sleep disorders are strongly correlated with weight management challenges.

cards.text: Sleep-deprived individuals exhibit elevated levels of ghrelin and reduced levels of leptin.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki hormonal durumu neredeyse birebir kopyalıyor; okuyucunun yaptığı bir çıkarım değildir.

cards.text: Inadequate sleep may influence dietary choices by altering the physiological signaling of hunger and satiety.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Metindeki hormon seviyelerinin değişmesini 'açlık ve tokluk sinyallerinin değişmesi', yüksek kalorili yiyecek tercihini ise 'diyet seçimleri' olarak başarıyla genelliyor.

cards.text: Sleeping eight hours every night is the best and only way to guarantee a healthy metabolic rate.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Sekiz saat uyumak en iyi ve tek yoldur' gibi metinde asla geçmeyen üstünlük, mutlaklık ve garanti iddiaları barındırıyor.

paragraph: The rapid adoption of electric vehicles is prompting electric utility companies to upgrade aging grid infrastructure. Peak charging times, which typically occur during early evening hours, threaten to overload local transformers unless smart-charging technologies are integrated. These technologies dynamically adjust charging speeds based on overall grid demand, ensuring stability without requiring immediate, costly physical expansions.

cards.text: Smart-charging technologies adjust charging speeds based on demand to ensure grid stability without physical expansions.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin son cümlesini neredeyse aynen tekrar ediyor; çıkarım değil sadece bilgi kopyalamasıdır.

cards.text: The integration of digital management systems can help mitigate the infrastructural strain of clean energy transitions.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Metindeki 'akıllı şarj teknolojilerini' 'dijital yönetim sistemleri', şebeke yükünü azaltmayı ise 'altyapısal yükün hafifletilmesi' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Electric vehicle grids will inevitably collapse worldwide if smart-charging technologies are not implemented by next year.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Gelecek yıla kadar kurulmazsa dünya çapında çökecektir' şeklinde metni aşan kesin ve iddialı bir felaket tahmini içermektedir.

paragraph: Unlike modern Portland cement, which often degrades within decades in marine environments, ancient Roman concrete has survived intact for millennia. Chemical analyses show that the volcanic ash used by Roman builders reacts with seawater to form rare mineral crystals that actively prevent crack propagation. This self-healing mechanism actually grows stronger over time as wave action continuously drives seawater through the structure.

cards.text: Utilizing specific volcanic materials in cement formulations can significantly enhance structural resilience against environmental degradation.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Roman betonundaki külü 'belirli volkanik malzemeler', deniz suyundaki dayanıklılığı ise 'çevresel yıpranmaya karşı yapısal direnç' olarak çok iyi soyutluyor.

cards.text: Ancient structural concrete formulations may offer modern engineers practical insights into designing highly resilient marine infrastructure.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Roma betonunun gücünü 'modern mühendislere dirençli deniz altyapısı tasarlama konusunda pratik içgörüler sunabilmesi' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Roman concrete is the most perfect building material ever invented in human history.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tarihteki en mükemmel yapı malzemesidir' diyerek metnin sınırlarını aşan büyük bir üstünlük iddiası barındırır.

paragraph: A comprehensive study in primary schools showed that gamified mathematics applications increased student engagement, but only during the first six weeks of implementation. After this novelty effect wore off, students' performance levels returned to their baseline unless teachers introduced new competitive mechanics. Researchers concluded that gamification is not a standalone solution for maintaining long-term academic motivation in children.

cards.text: Implementing educational games guarantees long-term academic success for all primary school students.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tüm öğrenciler için uzun vadeli başarıyı garanti eder' gibi metnin tam tersini savunan mutlak ve iddialı bir çıkarım hatasıdır.

cards.text: Gamified learning tools may require continuous updates or structural variety to maintain their educational efficacy.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Metindeki 'yeni rekabetçi mekaniklerin eklenmesi gerektiği' vurgusunu 'sürekli güncellemeler veya yapısal çeşitlilik gerektirebilir' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Gamification is not a standalone solution for maintaining long-term academic motivation in primary schools.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin son cümlesini neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalıyor; zihinsel bir soyutlama yapmıyor.

paragraph: As world oceans absorb rising levels of atmospheric carbon dioxide, the resulting decrease in pH levels reduces the availability of essential carbonate ions. Marine organisms, such as corals and shellfish, require these ions to build their calcium carbonate skeletons and protective shells. Without sufficient carbonate, these foundational species face structural weakening, potentially disrupting the entire oceanic food web.

cards.text: Slight alterations in atmospheric chemistry can threaten the survival of marine species that form the basis of aquatic ecosystems.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Karbondioksit artışını 'atmosfer kimyasındaki ufak değişimler', resif ve kabukluları 'sucul ekosistemlerin temelini oluşturan türler' olarak çok iyi genelliyor.

cards.text: Marine organisms like corals and shellfish require carbonate ions to build calcium carbonate skeletons.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki biyolojik gerçeği neredeyse birebir kopyalamıştır; çıkarımsal bir katkısı yoktur.

cards.text: Shellfish will completely go extinct in all oceans within the next fifty years due to carbon emissions.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Gelecek elli yıl içinde tüm okyanuslarda tamamen yok olacaklar' şeklinde metnin sınırlarını aşan kesin bir yok oluş tahmini içermektedir.

paragraph: Densely populated cities with abundant green spaces, such as public parks and vertical gardens, report significantly lower average summer temperatures than fully concrete neighborhoods. This cooling effect is primarily driven by transpiration, a biological process where plants release water vapor into the air. Urban planners emphasize that strategically distributed vegetation offers a highly cost-effective method to combat heat island effects.

cards.text: Densely populated cities with abundant green spaces report lower summer temperatures than concrete neighborhoods.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki sıcaklık kıyaslamasını neredeyse doğrudan kopyalar; çıkarım barındırmaz.

cards.text: Plants release water vapor into the air through transpiration, which drives the cooling effect.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki biyolojik açıklamayı doğrudan kopyalamıştır; çıkarımsal bir derinliği yoktur.

cards.text: Incorporating botanical elements into urban design can help regulate local temperatures and mitigate environmental stress.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Park ve dikey bahçeleri 'botanik unsurlar', ısı adasını azaltmayı ise 'yerel sıcaklıkları düzenlemek ve çevresel stresi hafifletmek' olarak genelliyor.

paragraph: Clinical trials of artificial intelligence models in radiology have demonstrated high accuracy in detecting early-stage lung tumors from chest X-rays. However, researchers noted that these models frequently produce false positives when analyzing images with complex scar tissue from previous infections. Consequently, radiologists stress that AI should remain a supportive diagnostic tool rather than a replacement for human clinical judgment.

cards.text: Machine learning systems in medicine may benefit from human oversight due to limitations in handling atypical anatomical variations.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: AI'ın yara dokularında hata yapmasını 'atipi anatomik varyasyonları işlemedeki sınırlılıklar', radyolog denetimini ise 'insan gözetiminden faydalanma' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: AI models show high accuracy in detecting lung tumors but produce false positives on complex scar tissue.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki teknik bulguları neredeyse birebir kelimelerle kopyalamıştır; çıkarım barındırmıyor.

cards.text: Radiologists will be completely replaced by AI diagnostic software within the next decade.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Gelecek on yıl içinde radyologların yerini tamamen yapay zeka alacaktır' şeklinde metnin tam aksini iddia eden aşırı bir gelecek tahmini verir.

paragraph: The expansion of trade along the Silk Road not only facilitated the exchange of luxury goods like silk and spices but also triggered the growth of specialized banking systems. Merchants developed early forms of credit and bills of exchange to avoid carrying heavy copper coinage over hazardous terrain. These financial innovations laid the groundwork for modern commercial networks across Afro-Eurasia.

cards.text: The logistical challenges of transporting physical currency over long distances stimulated ancient financial innovations.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Bakır para taşımaktan kaçınma zorluğunu 'fiziki para taşımanın lojistik zorlukları', kredi sistemlerini ise 'finansal inovasyonlar' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Merchants developed early forms of credit and bills of exchange to avoid carrying heavy copper coinage.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki cümleyi neredeyse aynen tekrar ediyor; satır arası okuma barındırmıyor.

cards.text: Without the Silk Road, modern commercial networks would have been completely impossible to establish.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'İpek Yolu olmasaydı modern ticari ağların kurulması tamamen imkansız olurdu' şeklinde aşırı iddialı ve karşı-olgusal bir neden sıçraması içerir.

paragraph: The routine administration of antibiotics in livestock feed has accelerated the emergence of drug-resistant bacterial strains worldwide. These pathogens can transfer from agricultural settings to human populations through food consumption and environmental runoff. Epidemiologists warn that without global regulatory caps on agricultural antibiotic use, common infections could once again become untreatable medical emergencies and threaten global health security.

cards.text: Industrial animal farming practices can create pathways for hazardous pathogens to enter human communities.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Hayvancılık yemindeki antibiyotikleri 'endüstriyel hayvancılık uygulamaları', bakterilerin insanlara geçmesini 'patojenlerin insan topluluklarına girmesi' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: If antibiotic use is not capped, antibiotics will never work again on any human disease.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Antibiyotikler hiçbir insan hastalığında bir daha asla çalışmayacak' şeklinde metnin sınırlarını aşan büyük bir mutlaklık ve felaket tahmini içerir.

cards.text: All infectious diseases will become completely untreatable globally unless antibiotics are banned from agriculture.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tarımda yasaklanmadıkça tüm hastalıklar tamamen tedavi edilemez olacaktır' şeklinde aşırı ve mutlak bir felaket tahmini barındırır.

paragraph: In countries heavily reliant on glacial runoff for electricity, accelerated glacier melting initially increases river volume, boosting hydropower generation. However, this temporary surplus is followed by a sharp, permanent decline in water flow once the glaciers retreat past a critical threshold. Energy experts warn that such nations must diversify their power grids immediately to prevent severe winter blackouts in the future.

cards.text: Temporary hydrological surges caused by climate shifts can mask long-term risks to energy security.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Erimenin ilk başta baraj sularını artırıp sonra azaltması durumunu 'geçici hidrolojik dalgalanmaların enerji güvenliğine yönelik uzun vadeli riskleri maskelemesi' olarak çok iyi genelliyor.

cards.text: Nations relying on glacial runoff must immediately ban all heavy industry to conserve water resources.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Su kaynaklarını korumak için tüm ağır sanayiyi derhal yasaklamalıdırlar' şeklinde metinde asla geçmeyen radikal bir politika önerisi ve mutlaklık içerir.

cards.text: Hydropower will become completely useless as an energy source for all nations within the next decade.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Gelecek on yıl içinde hidroelektrik tüm ülkeler için tamamen kullanışsız hale gelecektir' şeklinde metnin sınırlarını aşan mutlak ve aşırı bir gelecek iddiasıdır.

paragraph: Neurological studies on cognitive reserve suggest that elderly individuals who have spoken two or more languages fluently throughout their lives experience the onset of Alzheimer's symptoms up to five years later than monolingual peers. Brain scans show that bilingualism promotes greater structural integrity in white matter tracts, successfully compensating for gray matter deterioration during aging.

cards.text: Bilingualism is the most effective and guaranteed way to prevent any form of brain disease in old age.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Her türlü beyin hastalığını önlemek için en etkili ve garantili yoldur' şeklinde metnin sınırlarını aşan mutlaklık ve üstünlük iddiaları barındırıyor.

cards.text: Lifelong linguistic training may help the brain maintain functional performance by reinforcing its anatomical wiring.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Hayat boyu iki dil konuşmayı 'lifelong linguistic training', ak madde bütünlüğünün korunmasını ise 'anatomik yapının güçlendirilmesi ile fonksiyonel performansın korunması' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Elderly individuals who are bilingual will never experience any cognitive decline during their lifetime.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'İki dilli yaşlı bireyler hayatları boyunca hiçbir zaman hiçbir bilişsel gerileme yaşamayacaktır' şeklinde metni aşan mutlak (never, any) bir iddia taşır.

paragraph: Rapid deforestation in tropical regions has significantly increased the rate of zoonotic disease transmission to humans. When forest canopies are cleared for logging or agriculture, wild species are forced into closer proximity with human settlements, allowing pathogens to jump hosts. Epidemiologists emphasize that preserving intact forest ecosystems is vital to preventing future pandemic outbreaks across the globe.

cards.text: Disrupting natural wilderness habitats can create ecological conditions that facilitate the transmission of animal-borne pathogens.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Ormanların yok edilmesini 'doğal yaşam alanlarının bozulması', zoonotik hastalık bulaşmasını 'hayvan kaynaklı patojenlerin bulaşmasının kolaylaşması' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Zoonotic diseases will completely wipe out human populations unless all logging is permanently banned.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tüm ağaç kesimi tamamen yasaklanmazsa zoonotik hastalıklar insan neslini tamamen yok edecek' şeklinde aşırı bir felaket ve politika dayatması içerir.

cards.text: Preventing zoonotic disease outbreaks is only possible if humans completely stop entering any tropical forests.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Yalnızca insanların ormanlara girmeyi tamamen durdurmasıyla mümkündür' diyerek sınırları aşan mutlaklık (only, completely, any) barındırır.

paragraph: Surveys of young adults indicate that those who received basic financial literacy education during high school exhibit significantly lower rates of credit card debt in their twenties. These individuals are more likely to establish emergency savings accounts and understand the compound interest of credit cards. Consequently, economists advocate for integrating financial planning into standard high school curricula worldwide to foster economic stability.

cards.text: Young adults who receive financial literacy education will never experience any financial difficulty in their lives.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Hayatlarında hiçbir zaman hiçbir finansal zorluk yaşamayacaklar' şeklinde metinde asla geçmeyen mutlak bir gelecek tahmini içerir.

cards.text: Introducing basic economic education at an early stage can foster more responsible personal asset management in adulthood.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Lisede finansal okuryazarlık eğitimini 'erken aşamada temel ekonomik eğitim', daha az kredi kartı borcunu ise 'yetişkinlikte daha sorumlu kişisel varlık yönetimi' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Financial education is the single most important factor for guaranteeing lifelong personal wealth and business success.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Ömür boyu kişisel zenginlik ve iş başarısını garanti etmede tek en önemli faktördür' şeklinde metni aşan bir üstünlük ve garanti iddiası içerir.

paragraph: The widespread application of synthetic pesticides in intensive farming has led to a catastrophic decline in global insect populations, particularly wild pollinators. Because insects form the dietary base for countless bird, amphibian, and reptile species, their disappearance threatens to trigger a cascading collapse in terrestrial food webs. Researchers urge immediate transitions toward ecological pest management practices to protect agricultural ecosystems.

cards.text: Using synthetic chemicals to protect crops can destabilize terrestrial ecosystems by disrupting foundational food chains.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Sentetik pestisit kullanımını 'ürünleri korumak için sentetik kimyasallar kullanmak', böcek azalmasının besin zincirini etkilemesini ise 'ekosistemlerin dengesini bozmak' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Insects are the only species in terrestrial ecosystems that must be protected to prevent environmental collapse.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Böcekler çevresel çökmeyi önlemek için korunması gereken tek türdür' şeklinde metni aşan dışlayıcı ve mutlak bir iddia içermektedir.

cards.text: Terrestrial food webs will completely collapse in all continents within the next five years due to pesticide use.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Gelecek beş yıl içinde tüm kıtalarda karasal besin zinciri tamamen çökecektir' şeklinde metin dışı kesin ve felaket temelli bir gelecek tahmini içerir.

paragraph: Chronic exposure to urban noise pollution, particularly from highway traffic and airport operations, is clinically linked to elevated cortisol levels and sleep fragmentation. Over time, this constant physiological arousal increases the risk of developing hypertension and ischemic heart disease. Public health experts suggest that acoustic barriers and green belts along major highways are essential to protect residential communities from disease.

cards.text: Environmental auditory stressors can contribute to long-term cardiovascular health risks in urban populations.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Gürültü kirliliğini 'çevresel işitsel stresörler', kalp hastalıklarını ise 'kardiyovasküler sağlık riskleri' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Acoustic barriers and green belts along highways will completely eliminate heart disease in nearby cities.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Yeşil kuşaklar şehirlerdeki kalp hastalıklarını tamamen ortadan kaldıracaktır' şeklinde asılsız ve aşırı iyimser bir gelecek tahmini taşır.

cards.text: Urban noise pollution is the single most dangerous environmental health hazard facing modern humanity.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Modern insanlığın karşı karşıya olduğu tek en tehlikeli çevresel sağlık tehdididir' diyerek metinde olmayan bir üstünlük ve mutlaklık iddiası taşır.

paragraph: Proponents of deep-sea mining argue that harvesting polymetallic nodules from the ocean floor is crucial to securing the cobalt and nickel needed for green technologies. However, marine biologists warn that destroying these abyssal plains will permanently eradicate unique benthic organisms that grow incredibly slowly. They emphasize that recovering from such physical disruptions could take centuries in the cold, dark deep sea.

cards.text: Extracting mineral deposits from benthic habitats may cause long-term damage to fragile deep-sea biological communities.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Okyanus tabanından polimetalik nodül toplamayı 'biyotik habitatlardan mineral çıkarmak', bentik organizmaların yok olmasını ise 'kırılgan derin deniz biyolojik topluluklarına uzun vadeli zarar' şeklinde başarıyla genelliyor.

cards.text: Abyssal ecosystems are more important than any green technology development on the surface of the planet.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Derin deniz ekosistemleri yeryüzündeki her türlü yeşil teknoloji gelişiminden daha önemlidir' şeklinde metinde bulunmayan sübjektif bir kıyaslama içerir.

cards.text: We must immediately ban all deep-sea mining globally to protect benthic organisms from extinction.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Küresel olarak tüm derin deniz madenciliğini derhal yasaklamalıyız' şeklinde metinde bulunmayan radikal bir gelecek politika tasarımı ve mutlaklık içerir.

paragraph: Modern industrial agriculture relies heavily on synthetic nitrogen fertilizers, which temporarily boost crop yields but degrade the natural soil microbiome over time. This loss of microbial diversity makes plants increasingly vulnerable to pathogens, requiring even more chemical interventions. Sustainable farming advocates emphasize that nurturing beneficial soil bacteria is essential to restoring natural plant immunity against pathogens.

cards.text: The overuse of chemical nutrients in food production can weaken the natural biological defenses of crops.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Sentetik azotlu gübrelerin aşırı kullanımını 'gıda üretiminde kimyasal besinlerin aşırı kullanımı', bitkilerin patojenlere hassaslaşmasını 'ürünlerin doğal biyolojik savunmasının zayıflaması' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Replacing synthetic fertilizers with beneficial soil bacteria is the only possible way to grow crops in the future.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Gelecekte ürün yetiştirmenin tek olası yoludur' şeklinde metni aşan mutlak ve kısıtlayıcı bir çıkarım hatası yapılmıştır.

cards.text: Using synthetic fertilizers will completely destroy all agricultural soil on Earth within the next decade.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Gelecek on yıl içinde dünyadaki tüm tarım topraklarını tamamen yok edecektir' şeklinde metni aşan büyük ve korkutucu bir gelecek tahmini taşır.

paragraph: Neuroimaging studies show that children who are read to at home from an early age exhibit greater activation in the brain's left hemisphere, specifically in areas processing semantic information. This structural and functional development correlates with stronger reading comprehension and vocabulary scores when they enter primary school. Researchers emphasize that parental verbal engagement is a critical predictor of academic readiness.

cards.text: Early verbal stimulation within the household can support the neurological development of language-processing regions in children.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Evde kitap okunmasını 'ev içindeki erken sözel uyarım', sol yarımküre aktivasyonunu ise 'dil işleme bölgelerinin nörolojik gelişimi' şeklinde genelliyor.

cards.text: Children who are not read to during infancy will never be able to learn how to read properly in school.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Kitap okunmayan çocuklar okulda asla düzgün okuyamayacaklar' şeklinde metnin sınırlarını aşan haksız bir felaket tahmini içerir.

cards.text: Children who are read to at home will always be the most successful students in primary school.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Evde kitap okunan çocuklar ilkokulda her zaman en başarılı öğrenciler olacaktır' şeklinde mutlaklık ve üstünlük iddiaları barındırır.

paragraph: Massive blooms of Sargassum algae along Caribbean beaches are fueled by agricultural runoff carried into the ocean by major South American rivers. While these floating seaweed mats provide vital habitats in open waters, they decompose upon reaching shallow shores, consuming dissolved oxygen and suffocating local marine life. Coastal municipalities struggle with the massive economic costs of continuously clearing the beaches.

cards.text: Nutrient pollution entering marine systems from inland sources can trigger ecological imbalances along coastal zones.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Gübre sızıntısını 'karasal kaynaklardan deniz sistemlerine giren besin kirliliği', alglerin deniz canlılarını boğmasını ise 'kıyı bölgelerinde ekolojik dengesizliklerin tetiklenmesi' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Caribbean beaches will have to be permanently closed to tourists because of Sargassum decomposition.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Sargassum çürümesi nedeniyle plajlar turistlere tamamen kapatılmak zorunda kalacak' şeklinde metnin asla söylemediği bir gelecek senaryosu uydurmuştur.

cards.text: Tourism in the Caribbean will completely collapse next year unless agricultural runoff is immediately stopped.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Gelecek yıl Karayipler turizmi tamamen çökecektir' şeklinde metin dışı, aşırı iddialı bir zamanlı felaket tahmini barındırır.

paragraph: The integration of telemedicine platforms has vastly improved healthcare accessibility for rural populations living far from urban hospitals. Patients can receive specialist consultations and chronic disease monitoring without traveling long distances. However, healthcare providers caution that telemedicine cannot replace physical examinations for acute abdominal pain or complex orthopedic conditions, which require critical hands-on medical assessments.

cards.text: Digital healthcare delivery models can resolve geographic barriers to accessing certain types of medical consultations.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Kırsal nüfusun teletıp kullanmasını 'dijital sağlık teslimat modellerinin belirli tıbbi konsültasyonlara erişimdeki coğrafi engelleri çözmesi' şeklinde çok iyi soyutluyor.

cards.text: Physical examinations are always superior to telemedicine for diagnosing any kind of human illness.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Fiziksel muayeneler her türlü hastalığı teşhis etmede her zaman teletıptan üstündür' kıyaslamasını yaparak metnin sınırlarını fazlasıyla aşıyor.

cards.text: Telemedicine is the single most perfect development in the history of global healthcare systems.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Küresel sağlık sistemleri tarihindeki tek en mükemmel gelişmedir' şeklinde metinde bulunmayan aşırı bir üstünlük ve mutlaklık iddiası taşır.

paragraph: The growing density of decommissioned satellites and rocket fragments in Low Earth Orbit threatens future space missions with catastrophic collisions. Space agencies are testing active debris removal technologies, such as magnetic nets and laser harpoons, to clear defunct objects. However, aerospace engineers stress that international treaties must legally enforce satellite disposal protocols to permanently solve the orbital clutter problem.

cards.text: Resolving the hazards of orbital congestion may require a combination of technological innovations and binding regulatory frameworks.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Lazer kementlerini 'teknolojik inovasyonlar', antlaşmaları ise 'bağlayıcı yasal düzenlemeler' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Active debris removal technologies are the only way to save Earth from space collisions.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Enkaz kaldırma teknolojileri Dünya'yı çarpışmalardan korumanın tek yoludur' şeklinde metinde geçmeyen sınırlayıcı ve mutlak bir iddia taşımaktadır.

cards.text: Defunct satellites in Low Earth Orbit will inevitably trigger a chain reaction that completely destroys all space exploration.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tüm uzay keşiflerini tamamen yok edecek bir zincirleme reaksiyonu kaçınılmaz olarak tetikleyecektir' şeklinde aşırı ve mutlak bir gelecek kehanetidir.

paragraph: Aquaponics systems combine aquaculture and hydroponics, using nutrient-rich fish waste to fertilize plants grown without soil. The plants purify the water as they absorb the nutrients, which is then recycled back into the fish tanks. This symbiotic loop reduces water consumption by up to ninety percent compared to traditional soil farming, making it highly valuable in arid regions.

cards.text: This symbiotic loop reduces water consumption by up to ninety percent compared to traditional soil farming.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin son cümlesindeki istatistiği ve kıyası neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalıyor; özgün bir çıkarım değildir.

cards.text: Integrating aquatic animal farming with soil-less plant cultivation can offer a highly resource-efficient food production method.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Akvakültür ve hidroponiği 'sucul hayvan yetiştiriciliği ile topraksız tarımın birleştirilmesi', su tasarrufunu ise 'kaynak tasarrufu sağlayan gıda üretim yöntemi' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Aquaponics is the single best farming technique to eliminate world hunger once and for all.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Dünya açlığını tamamen bitirmek için en iyi tek tarım tekniğidir' gibi metinde asla ima bile edilmeyen devasa bir üstünlük ve mutlak hedef iddiası taşır.

paragraph: While Daylight Saving Time was originally introduced to decrease energy consumption by extending evening daylight, modern electricity data shows minimal actual savings. Instead, public health studies link the sudden shift in time to a temporary spike in workplace accidents and cardiovascular events due to sleep disruption. Consequently, policymakers are debating the permanent elimination of seasonal clock changes.

cards.text: Daylight Saving Time was introduced to decrease energy consumption by extending evening daylight.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki tarihsel amacı belirten ilk cümleyi neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalıyor; çıkarım değildir.

cards.text: Altering societal schedules can have negative physiological repercussions that outweigh minor economic advantages.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Saat değişimini 'toplumsal programların değiştirilmesi', az enerji tasarrufu ve kazaları ise 'fizyolojik zararların ekonomik faydanardan ağır basması' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Abolishing Daylight Saving Time will completely eliminate workplace accidents across the nation.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Saat değişimini kaldırmak iş kazalarını tamamen ortadan kaldıracaktır' şeklinde metni aşan kesin ve asılsız bir gelecek tahmini içerir.

paragraph: Urban rooftop gardens provide significant insulating properties, reducing the energy needed to heat buildings in winter and cool them in summer. In addition, these green rooftops absorb rainwater, easing the burden on storm sewer systems during heavy downpours. Environmental economists advocate for municipal tax incentives to encourage commercial property owners to adopt green roof systems.

cards.text: Vegetative installations on buildings can contribute to urban climate resilience and stormwater management.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Çatı bahçelerini 'binalardaki bitkisel kurulumlar', yalıtım ve yağmur emmeyi ise 'kentsel iklim direnci ve yağmur suyu yönetimi' olarak mükemmel genelliyor.

cards.text: Commercial property owners who do not install rooftop gardens should be heavily fined by the government.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Çatı bahçesi kurmayan mülk sahiplerine ağır para cezaları kesilmelidir' şeklinde metinde bulunmayan radikal bir politika dayatması içerir.

cards.text: Installing rooftop gardens is the single most effective environmental policy to prevent urban flooding entirely.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Kentsel selleri tamamen önlemek için tek en etkili çevre politikasıdır' şeklinde metni aşan bir üstünlük ve mutlaklık iddiası taşır.

paragraph: The Great Library of Alexandria, founded in the third century BCE, aimed to collect the entirety of human knowledge under one roof. While historical myths attribute its destruction to a single catastrophic fire, archaeological evidence suggests a gradual decline due to budget cuts and civil unrest. This loss of ancient scholarly works significantly slowed down scientific progress in the Mediterranean region.

cards.text: The destruction of the Library of Alexandria was the worst tragedy in human intellectual history.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'İnsanlık entelektüel tarihindeki en kötü trajedidir' şeklinde metinde asla geçmeyen öznel bir üstünlük kıyaslaması yapmaktadır.

cards.text: The degradation of central intellectual institutions can impede the pace of collective knowledge development.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Kütüphanenin gerilemesi ve bilimsel yavaşlamayı 'merkezi entelektüel kurumların gerilemesinin kolektif bilgi gelişim hızını engellemesi' şeklinde genelliyor.

cards.text: Alexandria Library had the goal of collecting the entirety of human knowledge under one roof.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin ilk cümlesindeki kuruluş amacını neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalamıştır; zihinsel çıkarım barındırmaz.

paragraph: Geothermal power plants harvest heat from underground reservoirs to produce reliable electricity regardless of weather conditions. Unlike solar and wind energy, geothermal systems operate continuously, providing a stable baseline for national power grids. However, the high initial cost of deep drilling and the risk of triggering minor seismic tremors remain significant barriers to widespread adoption.

cards.text: Harnessing subterranean thermal resources offers a consistent power supply but faces geological and economic challenges.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Yeraltı sıcaklığını 'subterranean thermal resources', delme maliyeti ve sarsıntıları 'geolojik ve ekonomik zorluklar' olarak çok iyi genelliyor.

cards.text: Geothermal power plants harvest heat from underground reservoirs to produce reliable electricity.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin ilk cümlesini neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine tekrar etmiştir; bir satır arası çıkarım değildir.

cards.text: Geothermal energy will soon replace all fossil fuels and become the dominant global energy source.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Yakında tüm fosil yakıtların yerini alacak ve baskın enerji kaynağı olacak' şeklinde metnin sınırlarını aşan kesin bir gelecek kehanetidir.

paragraph: Studies in educational psychology show that students who practice active recall, such as using flashcards or self-quizzing, retain information far longer than those who engage in passive review. Passive review, including rereading textbooks or highlighting notes, creates a false sense of mastery because the cognitive effort is minimal. Researchers advise teachers to design assessments that require active retrieval of knowledge.

cards.text: Methods that demand high cognitive exertion can lead to more robust memory consolidation.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Aktif geri çağırmayı 'yüksek bilişsel efor gerektiren yöntemler', bilginin akılda kalmasını 'güçlü bellek sağlamlaşması' şeklinde genelliyor.

cards.text: Students who only highlight their textbooks will fail every exam they take in school.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Sadece vurgulama yapan öğrenciler girdikleri her sınavda başarısız olacaktır' şeklinde aşırı iddialı, cezalandırıcı ve mutlak bir çıkarım hatasıdır.

cards.text: Rereading notes and highlighting textbooks creates the absolute worst cognitive habits for any learner.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Herhangi bir öğrenici için kesinlikle en kötü bilişsel alışkanlıkları yaratır' diyerek metnin sınırlarını aşan aşırı bir üstünlük ve genelleme iddiası taşır.

paragraph: Mangrove forests are highly efficient coastal carbon sinks, storing up to four times more carbon per hectare than terrestrial rainforests. Additionally, their dense root systems protect coastal villages from devastating storm surges and prevent soil erosion. Despite these benefits, mangroves are rapidly cleared for shrimp aquaculture, prompting conservationists to demand stricter coastal zoning regulations worldwide.

cards.text: Preserving coastal wetlands can offer dual advantages in terms of climate change mitigation and disaster prevention.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Karbon tutmayı 'iklim değişikliğini hafifletme', köy korumayı 'afet önleme' olarak genelliyor; 'can' ile temkinli, geçerli bir çıkarımdır.

cards.text: Mangrove forests store up to four times more carbon than terrestrial rainforests but are cleared for shrimp farming.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metindeki kıyaslamayı ve tehdidi neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalıyor; özgün bir genelleme içermiyor.

cards.text: Shrimp farming must be banned immediately in all countries to protect global mangrove populations.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Karides yetiştiriciliği tüm ülkelerde derhal yasaklanmalıdır' şeklinde metinde bulunmayan radikal bir politika dayatması içerir.

paragraph: Environmental studies indicate that remote work models significantly lower urban carbon emissions by eliminating daily automobile commutes. However, researchers point out that this reduction is partially offset by increased home energy consumption, especially in regions requiring heavy heating or air conditioning during extreme seasons. They argue that overall environmental benefits depend on regional grid dependence on fossil fuels.

cards.text: The environmental viability of decentralized work models may vary depending on local energy generation profiles.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Ev enerjisini ve şebeke yakıtını 'yerel enerji üretim profilleri', çevre yararını ise 'merkezi olmayan iş modellerinin çevresel sürdürülebilirliği' şeklinde genelliyor.

cards.text: Remote workers will always have a lower personal carbon footprint than office-based employees.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Uzaktan çalışanlar her zaman ofis çalışanlarından daha düşük karbon ayak izine sahip olacaktır' şeklinde metni aşan kesin ve mutlak bir kıyaslama içeriyor.

cards.text: Remote work models significantly lower urban carbon emissions by eliminating daily automobile commutes.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin ilk cümlesindeki tespiti neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalamıştır; çıkarım barındırmaz.

paragraph: Bio-prospecting in tropical forests often relies on the ethnobotanical knowledge of indigenous communities to identify plants with potential therapeutic properties. While pharmaceutical corporations have developed several blockbuster drugs using this method, indigenous groups rarely share in the financial profits. This has led to contentious international debates regarding intellectual property rights and ethical compensation protocols across nations.

cards.text: Using indigenous knowledge to develop pharmaceuticals raises ethical questions about equitable wealth distribution.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Etnobotanik bilgiyi kullanma ve kar paylaşamama durumunu 'adil servet dağılımı hakkında etik sorular ortaya çıkarması' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: Pharmaceutical corporations must give all of their profits to indigenous communities to be considered ethical.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'İlaç şirketleri etik sayılmak için tüm karlarını yerel topluluklara vermelidir' şeklinde aşırı ve öznel bir ahlaki yaptırım iddiası taşır.

cards.text: Without ethnobotanical knowledge from indigenous groups, no modern blockbuster drugs would have ever been developed.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Yerel toplulukların bilgisi olmasaydı hiçbir modern blockbuster ilaç asla geliştirilemezdi' şeklinde aşırı, karşı-olgusal bir neden sıçraması içerir.

paragraph: The explosive growth of e-commerce has led to a significant increase in cardboard and plastic packaging waste worldwide. Municipal recycling facilities are overwhelmed by the sheer volume of single-use shipping materials, much of which ends up in landfills. Environmental groups are pushing for strict government regulations that require e-retailers to adopt standardized, reusable packaging systems.

cards.text: The rapid expansion of digital retail channels can intensify the ecological challenges of waste management systems.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: E-ticaret artışını 'dijital perakende kanallarının genişlemesi', paket atıklarını ise 'atık yönetim sistemlerinin ekolojik zorluklarının yoğunlaşması' olarak genelliyor.

cards.text: All e-retailers will go bankrupt if they are forced to use standardized, reusable packaging systems.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Eğer yeniden kullanılabilir paket sistemine zorlanırlarsa tüm e-ticaret siteleri iflas edecektir' şeklinde metinde hiç geçmeyen aşırı bir felaket kehanetidir.

cards.text: Explosive growth of e-commerce has led to a significant increase in cardboard and plastic packaging waste.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin ilk cümlesindeki tespiti neredeyse doğrudan kopyalar; zihinsel bir çıkarım süreci yoktur.

paragraph: Micro-finance programs provide small, low-interest loans to aspiring entrepreneurs in developing nations, enabling them to start local businesses. While these programs have successfully empowered women and reduced poverty in many rural districts, critics point out that some borrowers become trapped in persistent debt cycles due to high interest rates from unregulated lenders in those areas.

cards.text: Small-scale financial interventions can foster local economic agency but also present risks of financial exploitation.
cards.label: valid
cards.why: Mikro kredileri 'küçük ölçekli finansal müdahaleler', borç döngülerini 'finansal sömürü riskleri' şeklinde çok başarılı bir şekilde genelliyor.

cards.text: Micro-loans are the absolute best way to eliminate poverty in all developing countries immediately.
cards.label: over
cards.why: 'Tüm gelişmekte olan ülkelerde fakirliği derhal bitirmenin kesinlikle en iyi yoludur' şeklinde aşırı iddialı mutlaklıklar içerir.

cards.text: Micro-finance programs provide small, low-interest loans to aspiring entrepreneurs in developing nations.
cards.label: under
cards.why: Metnin ilk cümlesini neredeyse kelimesi kelimesine kopyalamıştır; çıkarım barındırmayan bir tekrardır.

paragraph: For individuals diagnosed with celiac disease, a strict gluten-free diet is medically necessary to prevent severe intestinal damage.
